title: An existing shop keeps COD as its default after the release
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • Scenario: Your shop existed before the release and has never changed its default term, and you add a new customer.
  • You are an Admin user working at {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • The organization existed before the release, and its default has never been changed: the Credit Terms Log holds no "Default changed" row.
  • A name for a new customer, {Customer-A}.
    For example: {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST S11-01 Customer.
  • Starting screen: the Settings page.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Click "Credit Terms" in the Finance group.
  2. Click the "⋯" page menu beside "New Credit Term".
  3. Click "Audit Log".
  4. Open the Customers page.
  5. Click "New Customer".
  6. Type {Customer-A} in Customer Name.
  7. Click Save.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the page opens (no feature setting had to be switched on); COD carries the "Default" tag.
  • Step 2: the menu opens.
  • Step 3: there is no "Default changed" row, so the default has been COD since the release.
  • Step 4: the page opens.
  • Step 5: Credit Terms is prefilled with COD (Default).
  • Step 6: the field shows {Customer-A}.
  • Step 7: the customer is created on COD, as before the release.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11680 (Story 11, Release day: what changes for existing users)

  • S11-R1: “Every organization that exists at release keeps COD as its default for new customers. Nothing changes for new customers until a user picks another default.”
  • S11-R5: “New Customer now shows Credit Terms (prefilled with the default, COD for existing shops) and Credit Limit to users with 'View and Manage AP/AR Data'. Users without it see New Customer as before.”
  • Key Decisions: “Existing organizations keep COD as their default at release; organizations created after release start on Due on Receipt. No existing customer changes term.”
  • Key Decisions: “No feature flag. The feature ships to everyone; release-day behavior (Story 11: Release day) leaves existing shops exactly as they were until they act.”
  • Goals: “With no setup at all, existing shops behave exactly as before release (default COD, the same twelve terms), and new shops start on Due on Receipt.”
  • S11-R4: “The Credit Terms page appears under Settings → Finance for every user with 'Settings → Finance'.”
